desc: 瓷白硬光棚拍，干茶与冲泡双证，参数与凭证位全部留白
name: 罐装原叶散茶冲泡款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击：用硬光瓷白棚拍把罐型轮廓与体量交代干净，替掉源首屏的国潮插画山水。
一秒给出买理由：把源页三张描框卡片改写成三座实体瓷托上的三堆干茶，用实物承担信息而非图形。
shots.textZone: one headline placeholder in the clear upper band plus one short sub-line beneath it, both laid directly on the tile plane

shots.intent: 放大散茶最大流失点：开封后香气散失与受潮串味，让买家在自家茶格里认出自己那罐。
shots.textZone: one short headline placeholder in the clear headroom, laid directly on the tile surface

shots.intent: 用可见质地代替宣称：条索匀整度与断碎率在正俯微距下自查，等级与采摘时节字样一律不进画面。
使用代入并给出品类硬证据：一撮干茶入直筒杯、叶片在水中竖向舒展，说明本品必须冲泡而非即饮。
把源页散落各处的看图说话合并成一镜诚实对比：同一份茶冲前干条与冲后叶底同器同光同尺。
shots.textZone: one short caption placeholder under each dish, laid directly on the tile plane

shots.intent: 承接源页小档案参数表的骨架但清空全部事实：六行标签位与值位一律留白，规格日期保质期不进画面。
shots.textZone: six label tiles carrying short placeholders, all value slots intentionally blank

shots.intent: 让买家可选：同一罐型的三件并排只给轮廓差，容量与只数全部留白，替代源页规格字样。
shots.textZone: one short caption placeholder on each foot tile, capacity and count slots left blank

shots.intent: 承接源页质检段的结构但零事实：两块空白凭证瓷板与一枚空印章座，机构名标准号结论一律不生成。
shots.textZone: one short caption placeholder under each blank proof tile, seal socket left empty

shots.intent: 收口：罐与一杯茶汤立在全套唯一的深色实体锚上，只给空胶囊按钮位，折扣与时限字样一律不写。
shots.textZone: one headline placeholder in the clear upper band above one blank capsule bar carrying one short placeholder

style.backgroundSystem: real photographic space only, never a printed plane: a seamless porcelain cloud-white sweep #F2F2F5, a matte dove grey-violet tile plane #BDB9C9 laid on a table, one pale matte tile shelf #E6E5EA, and exactly one dark screen built from a physical matte black-glazed stoneware tray #24252B; no flat colour block, no hairline or arched outline frame, no paper band, no torn edge, no gradient glow, no landscape scenery
style.direction: cool high-key hard-light tea-caddy detail-page commerce built on real photographic space instead of printed panels
style.iconSystem: none drawn at all - zero pictograms, zero seal circles, zero numbered dots, zero badges; information is carried only by physical objects, by a hairline ruler tick strip in chartreuse #97A84B kept under three percent of the frame, and by blank raised porcelain proof tiles
style.lightingSystem: one unmodified hard key from the upper left at about 6200K throwing crisp defined cast shadows, large negative fill on the shadow side, small bounce card only on the lid edge; never a soft diffuse wrap, never shadowless beauty light, never a warm amber cast, never a glossy plastic sheen
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool high-key tea-caddy detail-page visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a porcelain cloud-white dominant field #F2F2F5, one matte dove grey-violet secondary plane #BDB9C9, pine-soot near-black #24252B reserved for lettering and for a single matte black-glazed stoneware object, and roasted-leaf chartreuse #97A84B used only as a hairline ruler tick below three percent of the frame; cool tone throughout; one unmodified hard key from the upper left near 6200K with crisp defined cast shadows and a large negative fill, never a soft diffuse wrap; every background is a real photographic space of seamless porcelain sweep, matte tile plane, freestanding solid riser blocks and shallow water film, never a printed colour block, never a framed outline, never a paper band, never a gradient; one lightweight tracked grotesque for headline and label placeholders set directly on the surface or printed on a physical porcelain tile, never boxed, never circled, never badged; zero drawn icons, zero seals, zero numbered circles; stable straight-on eye-level hero angle and scale with the caddy whole and unclipped; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no frames or badges, no flat colour panels, no soft shadowless lighting, no warm amber cast, no wood or paper texture backgrounds, no landscape scenery.
noDrift: no colour palette changes and no gold keylines, no teal field, no terracotta, no rice-paper or apricot accents
no mixed fonts, no serif display, no brush calligraphy, no vertical caption columns
no printed frames, arches, badges, seals, rounded cards or flat colour blocks behind the product
no soft shadowless lighting; one hard crisp cast shadow is mandatory on every screen
no wood grain, bamboo, linen, slate, marble or landscape backgrounds
no invented net weight, grade, origin, harvest window, brewing figures or lab data
style.presentationRules: the caddy stays whole, unclipped and at one stable scale on the same straight-on eye-level hero angle; loose dry leaf only ever sits in a shallow dish or on a riser block, never scattered on a graphic panel; brewed leaf shown as one vertical section through a straight-sided clear glass; one dark anchor object maximum per screen; shadows are the only graphic ornament
style.surfaceSystem: glazed and matte porcelain only: shallow matte porcelain dish #FFFFFF, freestanding solid porcelain riser blocks #E6E5EA, narrow glazed porcelain label and proof tiles #BDB9C9, one matte black-glazed stoneware tray #24252B as the only dark anchor, a shallow water film on cool grey acrylic #CFCCD8 for one screen; no wood board, no bamboo, no linen, no slate, no marble, no rice-paper texture
style.typography: one lightweight tracked grotesque used only for headline and label placeholders, headline 28-40pt, one sub-line 16-20pt, label 10-14pt, one weight per screen; lettering is laid directly on the photographic surface or printed on the face of a physical porcelain tile or capsule bar, always horizontal, never boxed, never circled, never set inside a badge, seal, card or frame; no serif display, no calligraphy, no vertical caption column
